headline: Premiumisation drives margin recovery; H2 ramp up the swing factor

highlights: Key Points  Revenue in line, PAT ahead: Revenue from operations was Rs4,387mn (+19.6% YoY/+3.2% QoQ), in line with our estimate.

Normalised revenue was Rs4,510mn (+26% YoY), with co-working up 31% YoY and Transform up 8% YoY to Rs750mn.  Reported EBITDA came at Rs1,737mn (+31.3% YoY/+7.1% QoQ) at a margin of 39.6% (+353bps YoY).

Cash EBITDA was at Rs487mn (+46% YoY/+10% QoQ), with margin at 10.8% (+145bps YoY/+65bps QoQ).  Supply growth is moderating while premium mix builds: Awfis added ~7k gross seats and exited ~2.2k in Q2, taking operational capacity to ~164k seats (+11.6% YoY/+3.1% QoQ) across 244 centres.
FY27 guidance remains at 22–25k gross additions and ~5.5k closures, targeting 174k+ operational seats by March 2027.
valuation: FY27 guidance remains at 22–25k gross additions and ~5.5k closures, targeting 174k+ operational seats by March 2027.

Of ~3k vacated enterprise seats, ~58% are committed, with 55–60% expected to generate revenue by December.  We maintain BUY and roll forward our valuation to 8x Sep-28E EV/Cash EBITDA (from 7x EV/Adj EBITDA earlier), and an unchanged TP of Rs364.
Outlook and Valuation: FY27 cash EBITDA guidance remains at Rs1,900–2,000mn (H1FY27 Rs930mn), implying Rs970–1,070mn in H2.
